coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Z is the component axis: into the page in the front view and horizontal in section A-A. Section A-A is viewed along the X direction, with Y vertical in the section view.

features.name: Overall width
features.description: The total axial width of the component from the leftmost face to the rightmost face.

features.name: Central bore
features.description: Central through bore with a concave curved internal profile. Defines datum axis A.

features.name: Annular groove
features.description: Radial groove separating the left and right geared sections.

features.name: Groove left side face
features.description: Vertical side face on the left side of the annular groove.

features.name: Groove right side face
features.description: Vertical side face on the right side of the annular groove.

features.name: Left gear outer diameter
features.description: Outer cylindrical surface of the left-hand geared section.

gdt_controls.applied_to: Outer diameter of left gear section

features.name: Right gear outer diameter
features.description: Outer cylindrical surface of the right-hand geared section. A shared runout tolerance applies to this and the left gear OD.

gdt_controls.applied_to: Outer diameter of right gear section

assumptions.text: Grouped front_view:F1 with section_aa:F2 as the same overall gear body/part-body observation. The section A-A cut is drawn through the overall body, and section_aa:F2 is the only part_body observation carrying the axial width dimension.
Selected section_aa:F2 as canonical for the overall body group because it has the explicit axial width callout, while front_view:F1 has no visible dimensions.

Did not group front_view:F1 with section_aa:F1, section_aa:F6, or section_aa:F7 even though the front-view body description mentions the bore and teeth; front_view:F1 is a broad overall body observation and is not feature-specific enough to merge with those individual features.
Anchored datum A to section_aa:F1 because that feature carries the Datum A cross-reference and the datum observation defines A as the central axis.
Interpreted the common runout context noted in section A-A as applying to both section_aa:F6 and section_aa:F7, consistent with the extraction note.
Proceeding with the merge as a single geometric component while raising a clarification about the possible assembly/Baugruppe indication.
The drawing represents a single, monolithic machined component incorporating all features depicted in section A-A, rather than a multi-part assembly.
The central through bore is centered on Datum A with an overall length of 22.7 mm, incorporating a symmetrical curved internal contour along its axis.
The inner (bottom) diameter of the annular groove is not dimensioned in section view A-A and is assumed to be specified in another view or detail callout.
The outside (tooth-tip) diameter of the left-hand geared section is controlled for circular runout within 0.08 mm relative to Datum Axis A.
The outside (tooth-tip) diameter of the right-hand geared section is controlled for circular runout to within 0.08 mm relative to Datum A.

The external gear tooth profile (item 2) comprises a straight spur gear profile with 43 teeth, an overall width of 22.7 mm containing a 2.7 (-0.2/0) mm relief groove, a radial runout tolerance of 0.08 mm relative to datum A, and a face perpendicularity tolerance of 0.05 mm to datum A.
